## Domain

Name the domain or workstream.

## Why this domain exists

Describe the responsibility boundary and why it must remain separate.

## What this domain owns

- List owned modules, workflows, or documents.

## Dependencies

- List upstream work that must exist before child implementation issues proceed.

## Child issues that belong here

- List the intended child slices.

## Rules

- This parent issue is organizational only.
- Do not attempt to complete the entire domain in one pull request.

## Done when

- Child issue inventory exists
- Ownership boundary is clear
- Dependencies are explicit
